description: Assessing a hide for durability before committing it to a binding. A simple manual check is to tear the skin: sound stock resists tearing and shows long silky fibres at the break, while weak stock parts easily and shows short curled fibres. Cockerell stresses that this mechanical check is only a first filter, since the strongest hide is not always the one that best resists light, heat, and gas fumes, and that reliable judgement of lasting power needs chemical analysis.
name: testing leather
